about.title: About PawCal Studio
about.missionText: To help pet owners live more conscious, healthier lives with their pets.
about.story:
PawCal was born in 2026 out of a real problem pet owners face: tracking daily data about our friends' health is hard, scattered, and not resistant to forgetfulness. A notebook, a calendar, a calculator, and our memory — all need to work at the same time.

At PawCal Studio, we wanted to end this chaos. We're doing for pets what modern tracking apps do for human health: a data-driven, science-based, yet user-friendly experience.

PawCal Studio is an independent software studio dedicated to helping pet owners live more conscious, healthier lives with their pets. From Turkey, to the world.
